issues.description: The problem statement's UML and description indicate addGuestStudents(int) should have a void return type, but the solution implementation declares addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value and may cause tests or expected usage (which expect void) to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the UML/specification by changing the solution's addGuestStudents(int) method to return void and simply add the provided number to numberOfGuestStudents (or, if a boolean return indicating success is intended, update the problem statement/UML and tests to specify a boolean return type and document the meaning).
